evals.prompt: Update Process and tests to satisfy README.md cancellation, result and cause contracts. Preserve its public signature and supported Go version.
evals.expected_output: Accepted progress and independent failures retain documented meaning under cancellation without panic or cause loss.
assertions: Already-canceled work never starts; standard cancellation classification and legal custom causes remain inspectable.
Independent callback failure and accepted progress survive coincident cancellation; completed success is not retroactively rejected.

evals.prompt: Update FetchAll and tests to satisfy README.md total/stage budget, response-lifetime and failure contracts. Preserve client/API/version boundaries.
evals.expected_output: Caller-derived total and stage scopes remain live through owned response consumption.
assertions: One total budget and an earlier parent deadline govern all stages.
Already/in-flight cancellation, retained completed bodies and owned-body closure follow the documented boundaries.

evals.prompt: Update Run and tests according to README.md required bounded finalization contract. Preserve the supplied command host and supported Go version.
evals.expected_output: Accepted work is finalized under an explicitly owned bounded scope, with actual process failure/effect observations.
assertions: Parent cancellation does not prevent required bounded finalization; completion is observed.
Processing and independent finalization failure remain inspectable; real child status and receipt retain accepted effects.
